consent.invitation: You are invited to participate in a research study conducted as part of a doctoral dissertation entitled:
consent.title: "Towards Transparent Geospatial AI: Investigating Strategies and Techniques for Explainability and Trustworthiness in AI-Driven Geospatial Decision-Making."
consent.acknowledgement: By participating in this study, you acknowledge that:
consent.point1: Your participation is voluntary and you may withdraw at any time.
consent.point2: Your responses will be used exclusively for scientific research.
consent.point3: All collected data will be processed and published in anonymized form.
consent.point4: No personally identifiable information will be collected.
consent.point5: The content of your responses will not be altered or falsified.
consent.agree: By providing your consent, you agree to participate in this study.
consent.consent-checkmark: I consent to participate in this study.

welcome.title: Welcome and Thank You
welcome.subtitle: Thank you for participating in this study.
welcome.description1: In this session, you will explore a set of maps related to wildfire susceptibility and answer questions about what you see.
welcome.description2: The study focuses on how different map designs support understanding of machine learning model explanations and uncertainty.
welcome.description3: There are no right or wrong visualization styles — we are interested in how people interpret them.
welcome.time-declaration: The session will take approximately 15–20 minutes.

tutorial.title: What You Will See
tutorial.subtitle: You will interact with maps showing wildfire susceptibility predictors for different regions.
tutorial.predictor-subtitle: Environmental factors related to wildfire susceptibility:
tutorial.predictor-footer: Values are shown using visual size, color, or patterns.
tutorial.shap-subtitle: Some maps show how strongly a predictor contributes to wildfire susceptibility.
tutorial.shap-footer: No prior knowledge of SHAP is required.
tutorial.uncertainty-subtitle: Uncertainty shows how reliable the model explanation is at each location.
tutorial.uncertainty-footer: Shown using blur, noise, patterns, or texture.

background.title: Background
background.b1-subtitle: How would you describe your experience with map and data visualisation?
background.b2-subtitle: How familiar are you with machine learning methods?
background.b3-subtitle: Have you previously used maps for risk assessment or environmental decision-making?

task1.title: Your Tasks
task1.instruction1: There are two type of tasks, each contains sub-tasks and a map with questions.
task1.instruction2: For each map, you will answer one or more questions.
task1.instruction3: Please answer as accurately and as quickly as possible.
task1.task1-subtitle: Please click on the area of the map that you believe shows the highest uncertainty.
task1.task1-title1: Task 1.1. Which region shows the highest uncertainty? Please select.
task1.task1-title2: Task 1.2. Which region shows the highest uncertainty? Please select.
task1.task1-title3: Task 1.3. Which region shows the highest uncertainty? Please select.
task1.task1-title4: Task 1.4. Which region shows the highest uncertainty? Please select.
task1.task1-title5: Task 1.5. Which region shows the highest uncertainty? Please select.
task1.task1-title6: Task 1.6. Which region shows the highest uncertainty? Please select.
task1.task1-confusing-title: How difficult was it to identify the area (rating 1-7)?
task1.task1-appealing-title: How visually appealing do you find this map (rating 1-7)?

task2.title: Task Type 2
task2.instruction1: This task involves interpreting bivariate maps that show the relationship between two variables.
task2.instruction2: The variables represented are feature and its SHAP value (feature impact on prediction).
task2.instruction3: For each map, you will answer one or more questions.
task2.instruction4: Please answer as accurately and as quickly as possible.
task2.task2-title1: Task 2.1. Highlight the area with: Highest feature value and Lowest SHAP contribution
task2.task2-title2: Task 2.2. Highlight the area with: Highest feature value and Lowest SHAP contribution
task2.task2-title3: Task 2.3. Highlight the area with: Lowest feature value and Lowest SHAP contribution
task2.task2-title4: Task 2.4. Highlight the area with: Lowest feature value and Lowest SHAP contribution
task2.task2-confusing-title: How difficult was it to identify the area (rating 1-7)?
task2.task2-appealing-title: How visually appealing do you find this map (rating 1-7)?

thanks.title: Thank you for participating!
thanks.subtitle: Your participation is greatly appreciated. The study is now complete.
